
```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
root = Path.cwd().parent.absolute()
```

Load data for one session
```{python}
sessions = list((root/"data").glob("ses*"))
ses = sessions[0]
spikes = pd.read_parquet(ses/"gabor_spikes.parquet")
stimuli = pd.read_parquet(ses/"gabor_stimuli.parquet")
stimuli["stim_presentation_id"] = stimuli.index
n_stimuli = len(stimuli['start_time'])
```

Select a single unit from V1
```{python}
spikes_v1 = spikes[spikes["brain_area"]=="V1"]
unit_id = pd.unique(spikes_v1["unit_id"])[2]
unit_spikes = spikes_v1[spikes_v1["unit_id"]==unit_id]
```

 Get unique stimulus coordinates and sort them
```{python}
unique_y = np.sort(stimuli["y_position"].unique())
unique_x = np.sort(stimuli["x_position"].unique())
n_y = len(unique_y)
n_x = len(unique_x)
```

Create mapping from coordinate value to grid index
```{python}
y_map = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(unique_y)}
x_map = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(unique_x)}
```

Count spikes for each stimulus presentation and add the spike count to the stimuli data frame
```{python}
presentation_spike_counts = {}
for idx, stim_row in stimuli.iterrows():
    start = stim_row["start_time"]
    end = stim_row["stop_time"]
    stim_id = stim_row["stim_presentation_id"]

    count = unit_spikes[
        (unit_spikes["spike_time"] >= start)
        & (unit_spikes["spike_time"] < end)
    ].shape[0]
    presentation_spike_counts[stim_id] = count

stimuli["spike_count"] = stimuli["stim_presentation_id"].map(
    presentation_spike_counts
)
```

Calculate the average receptive field map
```{python}
avg_counts_per_loc = stimuli.groupby(["y_position", "x_position"])[
    "spike_count"
].mean()

rf_map = np.full((n_y, n_x), np.nan)  # initalize 2D map

for (y, x), avg_count in avg_counts_per_loc.items():
    if y in y_map and x in x_map:
        row_idx = y_map[y]
        col_idx = x_map[x]
        rf_map[row_idx, col_idx] = avg_count
```

Plot the receptive field
```{python}
im = plt.imshow(
    rf_map,
    cmap="viridis",
    origin="lower",
    interpolation='nearest',
    extent=[
        unique_x.min() - (unique_x[1]-unique_x[0])/2,
        unique_x.max() + (unique_x[1]-unique_x[0])/2,
        unique_y.min() - (unique_y[1]-unique_y[0])/2,
        unique_y.max() + (unique_y[1]-unique_y[0])/2,
    ],
    aspect='auto'
)

plt.xlabel("X Visual Angle [$\\degree$ ]")
plt.ylabel("Y Visual Angle [$\\degree$ ]")

# Add Ticks corresponding to stimulus locations
plt.xticks(unique_x)
plt.yticks(unique_y)
plt.gca().tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45) # Rotate x-ticks if crowded

# Add Colorbar
cbar = plt.colorbar(im)
cbar.set_label("Average Spike Count per Presentation")

plt.title("Receptive Field Map") # Added a simple title
plt.grid(True, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5) # Optional grid
plt.tight_layout() # Adjust layout to prevent labels overlapping
plt.show()
```

Save the receptive field map to a file
```{python}
np.save(f"{unit_id}_rf.npy", rf_map)
```
